state: The required feedback module provides attributable suggestions, confidential individual votes, accurate visible totals, repeatable casting/withdrawal, retained moderation decisions, controlled submission/vote frequency, duplicate links with unchanged vote ownership, and private urgent support routing. Under DESIGN, an always-on lock also prohibits remove-delete; archived data participates in uniqueness; decision scans use bounded storage-owner authority; create hooks examine staged normalized data; scenario creates skip CRUD hooks; created is standard record metadata. Private text has no classifier primitive. Existing Vote locks account yet unvote permanently deletes it: the rules clash. Existing duplicate constraints exclude self and foreign products but not cyclic paths. In current Desk, Ticket.create remains support-only and requires can_work(actor,row.location). Its owner concurrently implements exported desk.open_request authorized for authenticated callers, requiring verified email and an active Location. Feedback's UI can use that canonical intake directly, leaving urgent body authored privately and never copying a published suggestion. Alternative A keeps unique suggestion/account Vote records with active plus cast_at. It locks account, turns off generated Vote mutations, makes vote create/reactivate its own record, and makes unvote deactivate without touching cast_at. No own retained Vote, archived ones included, may have cast_at>now-10s before casting; accepted casting stamps now. Public totals count active records. Only canonical Suggestion.create produces suggestions, and its hook counts the pending row together with archived submissions to cap each author at five over an hour. Initial hidden=true requires owner publication; owners retain a reason for visibility changes, and an author may edit pending content while moderation_reason is null. Visible public rows exclude hidden ones. A nullable duplicate must name another same-product root (duplicate==null); final-state dependency checks therefore prevent roots with inbound links from becoming duplicates, exclude chains/cycles, and do not reassign authors or votes. Alternative B drops the account lock and retains permanent vote deletion, stores additional durable submission/casting attempts to enforce hourly caps, publishes suggestions at creation with later staff hiding, and permits duplicate chains checked through a bounded ancestor walk. Each alternative requires aligned source, handwritten JavaScript and inline behavior cases; implementation of the language runtime/compiler is excluded. Classify the engineering balance without claiming correctness.

feedback_design.instructions: Choose the alternative with the stronger fit for the listed workflows, confidentiality, retained evidence, bounded admissions and economical authoring.

criteria.A: Use persistent active/inactive votes, a shared caller casting delay, submission-create quota, owner-approved visibility and same-product root references; state stays compact at the cost of chain restrictions and non-hourly casting admission.
criteria.B: Keep removable votes unlocked, add lasting traffic-attempt models, allow immediate visibility and traverse duplicate parents with a bound; chain support and hourly metrics cost extra records and leave content visible before review.
